title: Gatekeeper
pitch: A load balancer and reverse proxy built from scratch, the way real ones like Caddy and Traefik work inside.

milestones.title: Reverse proxy to one backend
milestones.spec:
Gatekeeper sits in front of a web server and passes requests through.

- Accept HTTP requests on one port and forward them to one backend.
- Copy method, path, query, headers and body; add an X-Forwarded-For header.
- Write an access log line per request: time, method, path, status, duration.
- Read the listen port and backend address from a config file.
milestones.promptPack:
Create a new Go module named gatekeeper. Build a reverse proxy that listens on a port from config.yaml and forwards every request to one backend URL from the same file. Preserve method, path, query, headers and body, add X-Forwarded-For, and log one line per request with time, method, path, status and duration. Use only the standard library for the proxy. Add integration tests that start two test servers (backend and proxy) and check GET, POST with a body, and header forwarding. Add a Makefile with test and run targets, and a README explaining how to run it.

doneWhen: go test ./... passes, including GET, POST and header tests

milestones.decisionPrompt: Why did you use (or not use) Go's built-in reverse proxy helper, and what would you lose by writing your own?

milestones.title: Many backends, pluggable algorithms
milestones.spec:
Spread traffic across several backends, and make the balancing method swappable.

- A Balancer interface with Next(request) returning a backend.
- Two algorithms: round robin and least connections.
- Choose the algorithm in config; adding a third must not change existing code (open for extension, closed for modification).
milestones.promptPack:
Add support for a list of backends in config.yaml and a Balancer interface with Next(r *http.Request) returning a backend. Implement round robin and least connections in separate files, selected by a config field. Track active connections safely. Add a test that sends 1,000 requests to 4 backends and checks the spread is even for round robin, and that least connections favors an idle backend when one backend is slow. Add a short section to docs/decisions.md on why the interface looks the way it does.

milestones.title: Health checks and failover
milestones.spec:
Stop sending traffic to dead backends and bring them back when they recover.

- Active checks: call a health path on every backend on an interval.
- Passive checks: eject a backend after N consecutive errors.
- Re-admit a backend after it passes checks again.
milestones.promptPack:
Add active health checks (configurable path, interval, timeout, healthy and unhealthy thresholds) and passive ejection after N consecutive 5xx or connection errors. Ejected backends are skipped by every balancer and re-admitted after passing the healthy threshold. Add a test that kills one of three backends during a 2,000-request run and asserts the error rate stays under 1% and that the backend rejoins after it restarts. Log every state change.

milestones.title: Session affinity and consistent hashing
milestones.spec:
Some clients need to keep hitting the same backend. Add affinity without breaking when backends change.

- Cookie-based sticky sessions.
- A consistent-hashing balancer with virtual nodes, keyed by a header or client IP.
milestones.promptPack:
Add an optional sticky-session mode using a signed cookie, and a consistent-hashing balancer with configurable virtual nodes keyed by a chosen header or the client IP. Add tests: the same key always maps to the same backend; adding a fifth backend to four moves roughly one fifth of keys (within a tolerance you justify); removing one moves only that backend's keys.

milestones.title: Safe under heavy concurrency
milestones.spec:
Prove the proxy is free of race conditions under load.

- Review every piece of shared state: counters, backend lists, health status.
- Fix races with the right tool: atomics, mutexes or channels.
milestones.promptPack:
Audit every piece of shared state in gatekeeper (connection counters, backend lists, health status, config). Fix any data race using atomics, mutexes or channels, choosing the simplest correct tool for each. Add a load test that opens 10,000 concurrent connections against 4 backends and run the whole suite with go test -race. Document each shared-state decision in docs/decisions.md.

milestones.title: Timeouts, retries, circuit breaker, rate limiting
milestones.spec:
Make Gatekeeper protect the system when backends misbehave.

- Timeouts on every backend call.
- Retries with exponential backoff and jitter, only for safe methods (GET, HEAD) or requests with an idempotency key.
- A circuit breaker per backend.
- A token-bucket rate limiter per client.
milestones.promptPack:
Add per-backend timeouts, retries with exponential backoff and full jitter (only for GET and HEAD, or requests carrying an Idempotency-Key header), a per-backend circuit breaker (closed, open, half-open) and a per-client token-bucket rate limiter returning 429 with Retry-After. Add a chaos test with one slow backend that shows the breaker opening, half-opening and closing, and a test showing over-limit clients get 429. Plot breaker state over time into a PNG or CSV for the README.

milestones.title: TLS, HTTP/2 and hot reload
milestones.spec:
Terminate HTTPS at the proxy and change config without dropping traffic.

- TLS with automatic certificates for real domains, and a self-signed mode for local tests.
- HTTP/2.
- Reload config on a signal with zero dropped requests.
milestones.promptPack:
Add TLS termination with automatic certificates (ACME) for configured domains and a self-signed mode for local tests, enable HTTP/2, and reload config on SIGHUP without dropping in-flight or new requests. Add a test that reloads config during a load test and asserts zero failed requests, and a TLS test using the self-signed mode.

milestones.title: Observability
milestones.spec:
See what the proxy is doing.

- A metrics endpoint: request rate, errors and latency per backend, breaker state.
- Structured JSON logs with a request id passed to backends.
- A small dashboard.
milestones.promptPack:
Add a Prometheus-format metrics endpoint with request count, error count and a latency histogram per backend, plus breaker state and rate-limit rejections. Switch logs to structured JSON with a request id that is generated if missing and forwarded to backends as X-Request-Id. Add a docker-compose with Prometheus and Grafana and a saved dashboard showing rate, errors and duration per backend.

milestones.title: Ship it and benchmark honestly
milestones.spec:
Package Gatekeeper and compare it fairly with a production proxy.

- A small container image.
- A compose demo with three backends.
- A benchmark against nginx or Caddy on the same machine, with method and limits written down.
milestones.promptPack:
Create a multi-stage Dockerfile producing a small image, a docker-compose demo with three backends, and a benchmark script that runs the same load against gatekeeper and against nginx or Caddy on the same machine (same backends, same concurrency levels). Write BENCHMARK.md with method, hardware, results tables for p50 and p99 latency and throughput, and an honest limits section.
